description: Two ways to use this. (1) Replace Dependabot: move it to the repository root and delete .github/dependabot.yml; running both on the same ecosystem produces duplicate pull requests. (2) Complement Dependabot: move it to the root, keep dependabot.yml, and set "enabledManagers": ["custom.regex"] so Renovate touches only versions.env and the base image ARG defaults in the Dockerfile, neither of which Dependabot updates. That does not collide with Dependabot's docker ecosystem, which owns the builder `FROM` line. Renovate needs its GitHub App installed. Either way, a bump of a checksum-pinned tool (TASK, TYPOS, ACTIONLINT) fails where that tool is installed until the *_SHA256_* lines are updated in the Renovate pull request; that failure is the reminder.

customManagers.description: Tool pins in versions.env, annotated with a renovate comment. extractVersion= handles tags that carry more than the version, such as helm-v1.2.3

The container base image, which the annotated manager above cannot handle: its currentValue is a whole reference rather than a version. `nonroot` is a moving tag, so the part that changes is the digest, and capturing currentDigest is what makes Renovate raise a digest update. versions.env and the Dockerfile ARG defaults hold the same pair and repo-lint fails the build if they drift, so both files are matched and land in one pull request. The two lines are matched as a unit and must stay adjacent.
